llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define auth screens in createNativeStackNavigator static config using screen-level `if` hooks (e.g., signed-in screens vs signed-out screens).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createNativeStackNavigator static config defines Login with `if: useIsSignedOut` and Home with `if: useIsSignedIn`.
evidence: Stack = createNativeStackNavigator({ screens: { Login: { if: useIsSignedOut }, Home: { if: useIsSignedIn } } })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must maintain authentication state and derive route availability from that state (signed in/out conditions).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Single `isSignedIn` boolean in App useState drives AuthContext; both `useIsSignedIn` and `useIsSignedOut` hooks derive from it.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: After successful login, Home must become the active available route and Login must no longer be available.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Calling signIn sets isSignedIn=true, making useIsSignedIn return true (Home available) and useIsSignedOut return false (Login unavailable).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: After successful login, back navigation must not return to Login.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When isSignedIn becomes true, Login is removed from the navigator via its `if` guard, so it cannot appear in the back stack.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must not imperatively navigate to Home/SignIn for core auth transition when using `if`-guarded routes; route switch should occur from auth state change.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No imperative navigation.navigate/replace calls for auth transitions; route switching is handled entirely by if-guard state changes.
